import sys

def add_mod(a, b, mod_value):
    a += b
    if a >= mod_value:
        a -= mod_value
    return a

def sum_series(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, m, mod_value = map(int, input_data[:3])
    data_idx = 3

    MAXN = 500
    c = [[0] * (MAXN + 1) for _ in range(MAXN + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        c[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            c[i][j] = add_mod(c[i][j], c[i - 1][j], mod_value)
            c[i][j] = add_mod(c[i][j], c[i - 1][j - 1], mod_value)

    dp1_first = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1_second = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1_first[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            w = (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j]) % mod_value
            w = (w * c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod_value
            sum_val = (sum_series(j - 1) + sum_series(i - j)) % mod_value
            dp1_second[i] = add_mod(dp1_second[i], (sum_val * w) % mod_value, mod_value)
            temp1 = (dp1_second[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j]) % mod_value
            temp1 = (temp1 * (i + 1)) % mod_value
            temp1 = (temp1 * c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod_value
            dp1_second[i] = add_mod(dp1_second[i], temp1, mod_value)
            temp2 = (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_second[i - j]) % mod_value
            temp2 = (temp2 * (i + 1)) % mod_value
            temp2 = (temp2 * c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod_value
            dp1_second[i] = add_mod(dp1_second[i], temp2, mod_value)
            dp1_first[i] = add_mod(dp1_first[i], (w * (i + 1)) % mod_value, mod_value)

    # Initialize dp2 arrays
    # Using 3D lists: dp2[0 or 1][i][j]
    dp2_first = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
    # Set initial states
    dp2_first[0][0][0] = 1
    dp2_first[1][0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
                # Update dp2[1][i+ln][j]
                dp2_first[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_first[1][i + ln][j], dp2_first[0][i][j], mod_value)
                dp2_first[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_first[1][i + ln][j], 0, mod_value)  # placeholder for clarity
                # Update dp2[0][i+ln][j+ln]
                val1 = (dp2_first[1][i][j][0] * dp1_first[ln]) % mod_value
                val1 = (val1 * c[j + ln][j]) % mod_value
                dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][0] = add_mod(dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][0], val1, mod_value)

                val2 = (dp2_first[1][i][j][0] * dp1_second[ln]) % mod_value
                val2 = (val2 * c[j + ln][j]) % mod_value
                dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][1] = add_mod(dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][1], val2, mod_value)

                val3 = (dp2_first[1][i][j][1] * dp1_first[ln]) % mod_value
                val3 = (val3 * c[j + ln][j]) % mod_value
                dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][1] = add_mod(dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln][1], val3, mod_value)

    final_ans = add_mod(dp2_first[0][n][m][1], dp2_first[1][n][m][1], mod_value)
    print(final_ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
